mapper.select: SELECT review_status, review_report_name FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{differenceId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.operator_id, u.display_name AS operator_name, a.comment, a.created_at FROM wf_task_action a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.operator_id AND u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO req_review_record (id, tenant_id, biz_type, biz_id, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, review_time, conclusion, comment, report_doc_name, created_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, 'DIFFERENCE', #{differenceId}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewerName}, #{reviewTime}, #{conclusion}, #{comment}, #{reportDocName}, #{createdBy}, 0)
